statement: An employer must give each new employee the Fair Work Information Statement before, or as soon as practicable after, the employee starts employment; the employer is not required to give the Statement to the same employee more than once in any 12 months.
caveat: Casual employees must also receive the Casual Employment Information Statement under section 125B, with repeat-issue points for non-small-business employers. The current Statement documents are published by the Fair Work Ombudsman (fairwork.gov.au, bot-walled at check time).
